end.summary:
Nisha discussed sharing one roti among three friends as equal shares.
They identified that one piece from three equal pieces is one third, but mixed this with the two pieces remaining.
They asked where the picture or point was on the phone.
Lesson ended before teach-back was passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised making three equal shares and connecting one piece out of three with one third. Nisha used the idea of three pieces, but mixed up the part eaten with the two pieces left; this was not corrected before the lesson ended. At home, share a paper circle or roti drawing into three same-size parts and ask, “What fraction is one part? What fraction is left?”
